meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 把随时间变化的数据拿来做预测、分类和异常检测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一串带时间戳的数据,想用现成算法做预测或找异常
copy.tagline_en: Forecast, classify, and flag anomalies in time-ordered data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have timestamped data and want ready-made algorithms to predict or spot anomalies

howto.what: Claude 会用 aeon 这个兼容 scikit-learn 的 Python 工具包处理时间序列，做分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测等任务，产出可运行的代码，并给出准确率、异常分数、变化点等结果。
howto.when: 当你处理按时间顺序排列的数据，需要分类、预测、异常检测等超出普通机器学习的算法时触发。原文要求 Python 3.10+ 并安装 aeon 包。

say.text: 用 aeon 的 RocketClassifier 帮我把这批时间序列分类
say.note: 会训练模型并给出准确率

say.text: 用 aeon 的 STOMP 检测这段序列里的异常点
say.note: 返回每个点的异常分数

say.text: 用 aeon 预测这段序列未来 5 个时间点
say.note: 拟合预测器并输出后续值

howto.what_en: Claude uses aeon, a scikit-learn compatible Python toolkit, for time series classification, regression, clustering and forecasting, producing runnable code plus outputs like accuracy or anomaly scores.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with time-ordered data needing specialized algorithms such as classification, forecasting or anomaly detection. Requires Python 3.10+ and the aeon package installed.

say_en.text: Use aeon's RocketClassifier to classify this time series
say_en.note: Trains a model and reports accuracy

say_en.text: Use aeon's STOMP to detect anomalies in this series
say_en.note: Returns an anomaly score per point

say_en.text: Use aeon to forecast the next 5 points of this series
say_en.note: Fits a forecaster and predicts ahead
